theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U N O : Set (Euclid P)) (pr p : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → N ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 pr O → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ H : Euclid P → Euclid P, AEStronglyMeasurable H μ ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖H x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ N ∩ U, H x = ∑ j : Fin P, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ pr x (p x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (p x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
